list: the official 55 trophies, verified 2026-11-20 against Exophase and PSNProfiles (55: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden)

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap
One More Game — GTA VI trophy list
EGamers.io — GTA 6 trophy list & hardest trophies

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own once the other 54 trophies are earned. It is the last trophy of every run.

steps.t: Work through the roadmap stages in order and tick each trophy off in this tracker as it pops.
Leave A Long Road (100% completion) for last: it is the longest grind and the usual final trophy before the platinum.
No online trophy exists, so the whole set is earnable solo and offline.
Check the countdown on this page: when 0 trophies remain, the platinum is yours.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the opening mission Gone Fishing. It cannot be missed.

steps.t: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing from the start of Chapter 1.
Follow the mission prompts until the mission ends; the trophy pops at the results screen.
It is a story trophy, so no preparation or free-roam work is needed first.
If it does not pop, finish the mission without skipping its final beat, then check the tracker.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. It pops as Chapter 2 begins.

steps.t: Play every Chapter 1 story mission in order until the chapter closes.
Start the first mission of Chapter 2: the trophy pops once the new chapter is under way.
Side content is optional here; the chapter trophy only needs the story missions.
Use the spoiler setting on this page if you want mission names hidden until they pop.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Play the chapter through to its end.

steps.t: Play every Chapter 2 story mission in order.
The trophy pops when the chapter closes and Chapter 3 opens.
Do the meditation spots and stranger strands that appear in this chapter while you are there.
No free-roam grind is needed for this trophy itself.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. Play the chapter through to its end.

steps.t: Play every Chapter 3 story mission in order.
The trophy pops when the chapter closes and Chapter 4 opens.
Clear any stranger strands and side missions that unlock in this chapter before moving on.
Keep the wanted level down between missions so nothing interrupts the story flow.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Play the chapter through to its end.

steps.t: Play every Chapter 4 story mission in order.
The trophy pops when the chapter closes and the finale approaches.
Finish the side strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone if they are still open.
Save before the final stretch so free-roam cleanup stays easy afterwards.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold story trophy for the final mission. One playthrough is enough and nothing here is missable.

steps.t: Finish the final story mission after Chapter 4.
Stock up on ammo and armour before starting it; the finale is a long mission.
The trophy pops at the mission results screen.
Free roam continues after the story, so every other trophy stays available.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Breakfast Run. It pops when the mission ends.

steps.t: Play the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears.
Follow the mission objectives to completion; no extra goal is hidden inside it.
It is unmissable: story missions always return if you fail and retry them.
Tick it off here and move on to the next story beat.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission The Cartel Heist. It pops when the mission ends.

steps.t: Play the story mission The Cartel Heist when it appears.
Bring a fast getaway vehicle and full armour for the escape.
Finish the heist objectives and the escape to trigger the pop.
It is unmissable and replays if you fail the mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Child's Play. It pops when the mission ends.

steps.t: Play the story mission Child's Play when it appears.
Follow the mission objectives to completion.
It is unmissable: failing the mission lets you retry it at once.
Check the tracker: this is one of the six named-mission story trophies.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Headliners. It pops when the mission ends.

steps.t: Play the story mission Headliners when it appears.
Follow the mission objectives to completion.
It is unmissable and retries cleanly after a failed attempt.
Note the chapter it belongs to so the roadmap stays in order.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission VCIA Takedown. It pops when the mission ends.

steps.t: Play the story mission VCIA Takedown when it appears.
Expect airport security on site; move fast once the takedown starts.
Finish the mission objectives to trigger the pop.
It is unmissable: retry the mission if it fails.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops when the mission ends.

steps.t: Play the story mission Operation Savage Glory when it appears.
Bring heavy weapons and armour: the operation is a big set-piece fight.
Finish the mission objectives to trigger the pop.
It is unmissable and retries cleanly after a failed attempt.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold for reaching 100% completion. Guides rank it the hardest trophy and the last one most players earn.

steps.t: Open the in-game 100% checklist and work through it line by line; it is the only authoritative progress list.
The checklist covers the story, stranger strands, collectibles and activities, so finish the other trophies first.
Guides rank this the hardest trophy in the set, ahead of the shooting range and the card sets.
Plan on a long grind: one guide estimates around 200 hours to the platinum, most of it here.
Use this tracker to count what is done: when every other trophy is ticked, only this checklist stands between you and the platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Silver for 250 stunts. The game counts each stunt toward a 250 target shown on PSN.

steps.t: Do stunts in free roam: jumps, airtime and near-misses all feed the counter the game tracks.
Watch the PSN counter climb toward 250; repeats of the same stunt still count if the game registers them.
Grind this after the story in open areas with ramps and long straight roads.
Mix vehicles: bikes and fast cars make different stunts easier to chain.
Check the counter in this tracker before each session so you know how many remain.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Bronze for trying each of the nine activity types once. Sampling is enough; mastery is not needed.

steps.t: Play one session of each of the nine activity types the game tracks.
Activities include the shooting range, drone races, fishing, arcade games and bowling among others.
One try each is enough: you do not need to win or finish first in any of them.
Tick the activities off in this tracker as you sample them so none is missed.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver for a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The longest skill grind after 100%.

steps.t: Visit the Shooting Range and work through its 42 challenges one by one.
A gold medal in every challenge is required; silver or bronze medals do not count.
Replay a challenge at once after a near-miss while the layout is still fresh in mind.
Guides rank the range among the hardest grinds, just behind 100% completion.
Track golds per challenge in this tracker and finish the last few in one focused session.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Bronze for winning a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations.

steps.t: Find the Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations across Leonida.
Win one race at each location; a win anywhere else does not cover a location you skipped.
Learn each course with a practice run before racing for the win.
Tick locations off in this tracker as you win them so no location is raced twice by mistake.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Bronze for winning 20 different races. Variety counts; winning the same race twice does not.

steps.t: Win 20 different races: each new race you win adds one to the count.
Repeat wins do not count, so keep moving to races you have not won yet.
Mix race types and vehicles so the 20 come from across the map.
Count your wins in this tracker and stop re-running a race once it is ticked.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Bronze for beating Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and out-fish him.

steps.t: Take on the fishing challenge against Cal when it becomes available.
Fish the challenge through to the end; the result is decided by the catch, not by speed alone.
Retry the challenge if Cal wins: fishing challenges can be attempted again.
The trophy pops the first time you beat him, so one win is enough.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Bronze for completing one arcade game. Any arcade game counts.

steps.t: Find an arcade machine in Leonida and start any game on it.
Play the arcade game through to its end; quitting early does not count.
Pick the shortest arcade game you can finish cleanly on the first try.
One completed game is enough for the trophy to pop.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Bronze for finishing Andy's mission strand. Follow it to its last mission.

steps.t: Meet Andy and play each mission in his strand in order.
The trophy pops when his final mission is complete.
Side strands stay available in free roam after the story, so nothing here is missable.
Watch for Andy's marker on the map between story missions.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Bronze for finishing Kenton's mission strand. Follow it to its last mission.

steps.t: Meet Kenton and play each mission in his strand in order.
The trophy pops when his final mission is complete.
Side strands stay available in free roam after the story, so nothing here is missable.
Watch for Kenton's marker on the map between story missions.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Bronze for finishing Billy's mission strand. Follow it to its last mission.

steps.t: Meet Billy and play each mission in his strand in order.
The trophy pops when his final mission is complete.
Side strands stay available in free roam after the story, so nothing here is missable.
Watch for Billy's marker on the map between story missions.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver for completing 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida.

steps.t: Find strangers with mission strands across the state; each strand is a chain of missions.
Finish all missions in a strand before it counts toward the 8.
Eight completed strands are needed; the five named contacts (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are a good start.
Explore towns and back roads between story missions: new strangers appear as you roam.
Tick each finished strand in this tracker so you know exactly how many of the 8 remain.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Bronze for finishing Randy's mission strand. Follow it to its last mission.

steps.t: Meet Randy and play each mission in his strand in order.
The trophy pops when his final mission is complete.
Side strands stay available in free roam after the story, so nothing here is missable.
Watch for Randy's marker on the map between story missions.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Bronze for finishing Tyrone's mission strand. Follow it to its last mission.

steps.t: Meet Tyrone and play each mission in his strand in order.
The trophy pops when his final mission is complete.
Side strands stay available in free roam after the story, so nothing here is missable.
Watch for Tyrone's marker on the map between story missions.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Bronze for meditating at all 18 spots. The only trophy guides flag as possibly missable: do the spots as they appear.

steps.t: Meditate at each of the 18 spots across Leonida; the PSN counter tracks them.
This is the one trophy guides flag as possibly missable, tied to a Chapter 1 meditation with Lucia.
Do every meditation spot as soon as it appears, before the story moves past it.
Check the counter before finishing the story: a missed spot may not come back.
Meditation spots are part of the 100% checklist, so finishing them also feeds A Long Road.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bronze for hunting a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand to the hunt.

steps.t: Meet Bret and follow his strand until the hunt is offered.
Track the unique animal Bret names; it is a one-off hunt, not a random encounter.
Bring a scoped rifle and approach quietly so the animal does not flee.
The trophy pops when the hunt is complete and Bret's strand moves on.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Silver for completing 3 collectible card sets. Find every card in three full sets.

steps.t: Collect cards across Leonida; each card belongs to one set.
A set only counts when every card in it is found, so finish sets one at a time.
Three completed sets are needed; cards are hidden in towns, shops and out-of-the-way spots.
Guides rank the card sets among the longer collectible grinds, behind only 100%.
Tick each finished set in this tracker and keep the remaining cards on your route.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Silver for using WAiNK It at 100 locations. The PSN counter tracks each new location.

steps.t: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations across Leonida.
Repeat visits to the same location do not add to the count; only new spots do.
Sweep town by town so no location is visited twice by mistake.
Fold WAiNK stops into your exploration route for The Goodtime State.
Watch the counter toward 100 in this tracker before each session.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Bronze for completing 50 challenges. Any 50 challenges across the game's systems count.

steps.t: Complete any 50 challenges: activities, stunts, races and side tasks all feed the total.
Pick the easiest challenges first to bank the first 25 quickly.
Challenges you finish for other trophies count here too, so this pops naturally late in a run.
Check the counter in this tracker and chase the remaining few deliberately at the end.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Bronze for losing a 4-star wanted level together with your partner and escaping.

steps.t: Raise a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you.
Break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the wanted level clears.
Use fast vehicles and back roads; hiding in alleys beats outrunning every unit.
Both of you must escape: the trophy pops only when the heat is fully gone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Bronze for robbing 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while keeping your wanted level.

steps.t: Rob a shop with your partner, then move straight to the next shop without a break.
Three shops in a row are needed, all in one run.
Keep your wanted level alive the whole time: losing it resets the chain.
Pick three shops close together and plan the route before the first robbery.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Bronze for discovering 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you enter counts once.

steps.t: Enter 100 different vehicles; each new one adds to the PSN counter.
Repeats do not count, so keep trying cars, bikes, boats and trucks you have not driven.
Sweep car parks, dealerships and quiet streets for models you have not found yet.
Fold vehicle hunting into exploration for The Goodtime State.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Bronze for taking down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus.

steps.t: Find a spot with at least five enemies grouped close together.
Trigger Combat Focus only once the group is in range and in sight.
Take all five down before Focus ends; kills after it ends do not count.
Retry in free roam if the group scatters: the attempt costs nothing but time.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Bronze for an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the Vice City airport.

steps.t: Go to VCIA, the Vice City International Airport, in free roam.
Leave by an unscheduled route: take an aircraft out without following the normal departure.
Expect airport security to react, so be ready to fly out fast.
The trophy pops once you are airborne and clear of the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Bronze tied to Rhino tanks. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed in game, so treat the steps below as the reported reading, not a verified method.

steps.t: Find Rhino tanks in free roam once your wanted level is high enough for the army to respond.
The description points at the Rhinos themselves, so the trophy involves the tanks, not ordinary police.
This method is not yet confirmed in game: check a fresh guide before grinding it.
Do not chase it early; leave cryptic trophies for the endgame cleanup.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Bronze for robbing a jewelry store without being detected. Stealth is the whole job.

steps.t: Pick a jewelry store and case it first: note cameras, guards and exits.
Strike quietly and avoid every camera and guard line of sight.
Leave before the alarm trips; detection at any point voids the attempt.
Retry after a failed run: a detected attempt costs nothing but the restart.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Silver for robbing 5 bank vaults and escaping each time.

steps.t: Rob five different bank vaults; each robbery and escape counts once.
Plan the escape before the robbery: know the getaway vehicle and route.
Escape cleanly after each vault: getting caught voids that vault's count.
Space the vaults out across sessions if the heat gets too heavy.
Tick each escaped vault in this tracker toward the 5.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Bronze for robbing an armored truck and escaping.

steps.t: Find an armored truck on the road in free roam.
Stop the truck and take its cargo.
Escape the police response before the trophy can pop.
A fast getaway car parked nearby makes the escape far easier.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Bronze for exploring all 52 areas of Leonida.

steps.t: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida; the PSN counter tracks each new area.
Drive the full map edge to edge, including the Keys and the northern countryside.
Fold area visits into WAiNK stops and card hunting so one route serves three trophies.
Check the in-game map for grey, unvisited regions and clear them last.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Bronze for robbing one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs.

steps.t: Find the illegal operations run by each of the 9 gangs across Leonida.
Rob one operation per gang; a second hit on the same gang adds nothing.
Expect armed resistance at each site and plan an escape route first.
Tick each gang off in this tracker so you know which of the 9 remain.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Bronze for enjoying a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

steps.t: Go to Ocean Beach in Vice City and find a bar with a sea view.
Order a cocktail and enjoy it with the view: the trophy is about the moment, not a fight.
Stay until the scene registers; rushing off can cut the moment short.
Do it early in free roam: it is a quick, relaxing trophy between grinds.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Bronze for smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.

steps.t: Find a vehicle showroom in Leonida and get inside with a car.
Smash out through the showroom front in classic style: straight through the glass.
Use a sturdy, fast car so the smash does not stall halfway out.
Expect a wanted level on the way out and have a getaway route ready.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bronze for a follow-through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.

steps.t: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Leonida.
Play a game of bowling and follow through on your shots.
Finish the game: walking out mid-game does not count.
Bowling also counts toward the nine activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Bronze with a deliberately vague description. The unlock is not yet confirmed in game, so treat the steps below as the reported reading.

steps.t: The description points at a partnership moment with wide appeal, likely with your partner.
Play partner activities and story beats together and watch for the pop.
This method is not yet confirmed in game: check a fresh guide before grinding it.
Leave cryptic trophies for the endgame cleanup, after the counted trophies are done.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Bronze tied to choices made through the story. PSN tracks a count toward 500, and the trophy hints a story choice matters.

steps.t: Make story choices as they come: the trophy tracks choices, with a PSN count toward 500.
The description hints a story choice matters, so think before picking a side in the big decisions.
Keep a manual save before each major choice in case a decision locks something out.
Whether any choice is truly missable is not yet confirmed: treat the save habit as cheap insurance.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Bronze with a deliberately vague description. The unlock is not yet confirmed in game.

steps.t: The description points at succeeding on a second attempt after a first failure.
Fail an activity or challenge once, then succeed at it on the immediate retry.
This method is not yet confirmed in game: check a fresh guide before grinding it.
Leave cryptic trophies for the endgame cleanup, after the counted trophies are done.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Bronze with a deliberately vague description. Guides list it as unconfirmed: a strange event somewhere in Leonida.

steps.t: The description points at witnessing something strange and unexplained.
Guides list this trophy's method as unconfirmed, with no verified trigger yet.
Explore odd corners of the map in free roam: strange events hide off the main roads.
Check a fresh guide before grinding it: this is the least certain trophy in the set.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bronze for knocking someone over with a melee drive-by. The precise method is still being confirmed.

steps.t: Perform a drive-by attack with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle.
Knock the target over with the melee hit: the drive-by must connect, not just swing.
Guides note the precise method is still being confirmed, so expect the details to shift.
Try it on slow-moving targets in quiet streets where the hit is easy to land.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Bronze for laundering a cumulative $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts.

steps.t: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and heists across the game.
Launder them through your contacts; only laundered money counts toward the $250,000.
The total is cumulative across the whole run, so launder little and often.
Bank the laundered cash toward garage properties and the $100,000 spending trophy.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Bronze for spending a cumulative $100,000 across all shops.

steps.t: Spend $100,000 in total across any shops in Leonida.
The total is cumulative: clothes, weapons, food and car parts all count.
Buy useful gear first, then top up with big purchases if the total falls short.
Track spending against the laundered cash from Dime on the Dollar.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Bronze for purchasing all 8 garage properties.

steps.t: Buy all 8 purchasable garage properties across Leonida.
Garages cost serious money, so save the laundered cash for them.
Visit each garage location to confirm the purchase registers.
Tick each bought garage in this tracker toward the 8.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Bronze for registering 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

steps.t: Open the Scooter Bros app and register vehicles you own or find.
Ten registered vehicles are needed; each new registration adds one.
Register the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good to serve two trophies at once.
Check the app's list so you do not register the same vehicle twice.
